mentions.name: Pluks
mentions.description: This Mac app streamlines copy-paste into two steps: selecting text copies it, and a deep click pastes it into the target window, replacing the native four-step select/CMD+C/window-switch/CMD+V flow.
mentions.problem: Copy-pasting on Mac is natively a four-step process that people perform many times a day, and the author wanted to reduce it to two steps.
mentions.source_excerpt: I made a select-to-copy app [https://pluks.app]. I recently realised copy paste is a 4 step process on mac (natively) - select copy (CMD+C) and then activating the window to be pasted in then CMD V, a simple select to copy and deep click paste will bring this action that we do maybe 100 times a day to 2 steps from 4.
